      $("#t2").textContent = `\u{1F552} ${fmtT()} ${S.weather === "rain" ? "\u{1F327}\uFE0F" : S.weather === "snow" ? "\u{1F328}\uFE0F" : "\u2600\uFE0F"}`;
      $("#t3").textContent = `\u{1F4B0} ${Math.floor(S.money)} \u062C`;
      const B = [["\u26A1 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0627\u0642\u0629", S.energy, "#ffd23f"], ["\u{1F37D}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u062C\u0648\u0639", S.hunger, "#ff8a4c"], ["\u{1F60A} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0632\u0627\u062C", S.mood, "#ff6fa5"], ["\u{1F4DA} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0639\u0631\u0641\u0629", S.know, "#4fb4ff"], ["\u2728 \u0627\u0644\u062C\u0627\u0630\u0628\u064A\u0629", S.charm, "#b583ff"], ["\u{1F469}\u200D\u{1F373} \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0628\u062E", S.cook, "#4cd37b"]];
      $("#bars").innerHTML = B.map((b) => `<div class="ag-bar">${b[0]}<i><b style="width:${clamp(b[1], 0, 100)}%;background:${b[2]}"></b></i></div>`).join("");
      const goal = isFest() ? `\u{1F3EE} \u0627\u0644\u0646\u0647\u0627\u0631\u062F\u0629 ${FEST[sIdx()]} \u0641\u064A \u0627\u0644\u062D\u062F\u064A\u0642\u0629 \u0645\u0646 4 \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0635\u0631!` : S.know >= 100 && S.partner ? "\u{1F389} \u0643\u0645\u0644\u062A \u0643\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0647\u062F\u0627\u0641! \u0643\u0645\u0651\u0644 \u062D\u064A\u0627\u062A\u0643 \u0628\u0631\u0627\u062D\u062A\u0643" : !S.partner && S.know < 100 ? `\u{1F3AF} \u0647\u062F\u0641\u0643: \u062E\u0644\u0651\u0635 \u062F\u0631\u0627\u0633\u062A\u0643 (${Math.floor(S.know)}/100) \u0648\u0627\u0628\u062D\u062B \u0639\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u062D\u0628` : S.know < 100 ? `\u{1F3AF} \u0647\u062F\u0641\u0643: \u0643\u0645\u0651\u0644 \u062F\u0631\u0627\u0633\u062A\u0643 (${Math.floor(S.know)}/100)` : "\u{1F3AF} \u0647\u062F\u0641\u0643: \u0644\u0627\u0642\u064A \u0627\u0644\u062D\u0628 \u2764\uFE0F";
      $("#goal").textContent = goal;
    }
    function stat(k, d) {
      S[k] = clamp(S[k] + d, 0, 100);
    }
    function spend(n) {
      if (S.money < n) {
        toast("\u0641\u0644\u0648\u0633\u0643 \u0645\u0634 \u0643\u0641\u0627\u064A\u0629 \u{1F4B8}");
        return false;
      }
      S.money -= n;
      return true;
    }
    function pass(mins) {
      if (S.pet) {
        S.pet.hun = clamp(S.pet.hun - mins * 0.02, 0, 100);
        S.pet.joy = clamp(S.pet.joy - mins * (S.pet.hun < 20 ? 0.04 : 0.012), 0, 100);
      }
      S.min += mins;
      stat("hunger", -mins * 0.035);
      stat("energy", -mins * 0.015);
      while (S.min >= 1440) {
        S.min -= 1440;
        S.day++;
        newDay();
      }
      if (S.hunger <= 0) stat("mood", -mins * 0.03);
    }
    function newDay() {
      for (const n of Object.keys(S.npcs)) {
        if (S.partner === n) S.npcs[n].aff = Math.max(40, S.npcs[n].aff - (S.talkedToday[n] ? 0 : 4));
        else S.npcs[n].aff = Math.max(0, S.npcs[n].aff - (S.talkedToday[n] ? 0 : 1));
      }
      S.talkedToday = {};
      S.workToday = 0;
      S.weather = Math.random() < 0.28 ? sIdx() === 3 ? "snow" : "rain" : "clear";
      if (sIdx() === 3 && S.weather === "clear" && Math.random() < 0.4) S.weather = "snow";
      let fm = 0;
      S.furn.forEach((k) => {
        if (k === "shelf") fm += 3;
        else if (k !== "bed" && k !== "desk") fm += 2;
      });
      if (fm) stat("mood", fm);
      if (S.pet) {
        stat("mood", S.pet.joy > 50 ? 4 : -3);
      }
      if (S.day % 7 === 0) S.examDone = false;
    }
    function sleepNow() {
      const h = S.min / 60;
      let wake = 7 * 60;
      const hours = h < 7 ? 7 - h : 24 - h + 7;
      if (h >= 7) S.day++, newDay();
      else newDay();
      S.min = wake;
      S.energy = clamp(40 + hours * 9 + (S.furn.includes("bed") ? 12 : 0), 50, 100);
      S.hunger = Math.max(20, S.hunger - 25);
      stat("mood", 8);
      toast(`\u0635\u062D\u064A\u062A \u064A\u0648\u0645 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F: ${DAYS[S.day % 7]} \u2600\uFE0F`);
    }
    function faint() {
      S.energy = 0;
      toast(g("\u0623\u063A\u0645\u064A \u0639\u0644\u064A\u0643", "\u0623\u063A\u0645\u064A \u0639\u0644\u064A\u0643\u064A") + " \u0645\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u062A\u0639\u0628! \u0627\u062A\u0646\u0642\u0644\u062A \u0644\u0644\u0628\u064A\u062A \u{1F635}");
      P.x = PLACES.home.dx;
      P.y = PLACES.home.dy + 20;
      sleepNow();
      stat("mood", -10);
      S.money = Math.max(0, S.money - 20);
    }
    let curBg = null;
    function closePanel() {
      curBg = null;
      $("#panel").style.display = "none";
      panelOpen = false;
    }
    function openPanel(html) {
      $("#panel").style.backgroundImage = curBg ? `linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.05),rgba(0,0,0,.35)),url(${BG[curBg]})` : "none";
      $("#sheet").innerHTML = html;
      $("#panel").style.display = "flex";
      panelOpen = true;
      $("#sheet").scrollTop = 0;
    }
    function esc(s) {
      return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]);
    }
    let actMap = {};
    function menu(title, body, items, opt = {}) {
      actMap = {};
      let h = `<h3>${esc(title)}</h3>`;
      if (opt.npc) {
        h = `<div class="ag-port"><img class="ag-pimg" src="${PORT[opt.npc.id]}" alt=""><div style="flex:1"><h3>${esc(title)}</h3>${opt.sub || ""}</div></div>`;
      }
      if (body) h += `<p>${body}</p>`;
      items.forEach((it, i) => {
        actMap["o" + i] = it.fn;
        h += `<button class="ag-opt${it.cls ? " " + it.cls : ""}" data-k="o${i}"${it.dis ? " disabled" : ""}>${esc(it.t)}${it.s ? `<small>${esc(it.s)}</small>` : ""}</button>`;
      });
      if (!opt.noClose) {
        actMap.cl = closePanel;
        h += `<button class="ag-opt close" data-k="cl">\u0625\u063A\u0644\u0627\u0642</button>`;
      }
      openPanel(h);
    }
    $("#sheet").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("button[data-k]");
      if (!b || b.disabled) return;
      const f = actMap[b.dataset.k];
      if (f) f();
    });
    function afterAct() {
      hud();
      if (S.energy <= 0) faint();
    }
    function menuHome() {
      curBg = "home";
      menu("\u{1F3E0} \u0627\u0644\u0628\u064A\u062A", `\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 ${fmtT()}. \u0625\u064A\u0647 \u0627\u0644\u0644\u064A \u0647\u062A\u0639\u0645\u0644\u0647\u061F`, [
        { t: "\u{1F634} \u0646\u0648\u0645", s: S.min / 60 < 20 && S.min / 60 >= 7 ? "\u062A\u0642\u062F\u0631 \u062A\u0646\u0627\u0645 \u0628\u062F\u0631\u064A \u0628\u0633 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0627\u0642\u0629 \u0647\u062A\u062A\u0639\u0648\u0636 \u0623\u0642\u0644" : "\u062A\u0631\u062C\u0639 \u064A\u0648\u0645 \u062C\u062F\u064A\u062F \u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 7 \u0627\u0644\u0635\u0628\u062D", fn: () => {
          closePanel();
          sleepNow();
          hud();
        } },
        { t: "\u{1F373} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0637\u0628\u062E (\u0637\u0628\u062E)", s: `\u0645\u0633\u062A\u0648\u0649 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0628\u062E ${Math.floor(S.cook)}`, fn: menuCook },
        { t: "\u{1F457} \u0627\u0644\u062E\u0632\u0627\u0646\u0629 (\u062A\u063A\u064A\u064A\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0644\u0627\u0628\u0633)", fn: menuWardrobe },
        { t: "\u{1F6CB}\uFE0F \u062A\u062C\u0647\u064A\u0632 \u0627\u0644\u063A\u0631\u0641\u0629", s: `\u0645\u0639\u0627\u0643 ${S.furn.length} \u0645\u0646 ${Object.keys(FURN).length} \u0642\u0637\u0639`, fn: menuRoom },
        { t: "\u{1F4D6} \u0645\u0630\u0627\u0643\u0631\u0629 \u0641\u064A \u0627\u0644\u0628\u064A\u062A", s: "\u0633\u0627\u0639\u062A\u064A\u0646 \u2022 \u0645\u0639\u0631\u0641\u0629 +3 \u2022 \u0637\u0627\u0642\u0629 -12", fn: () => {
          if (S.energy < 14) return toast("\u0623\u0646\u062A \u062A\u0639\u0628\u0627\u0646\u060C \u0646\u0627\u0645 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0648\u0644");
          const kb = 3 + (S.furn.includes("desk") ? 1 : 0);
          stat("know", kb);
          stat("energy", -12);
          stat("mood", -3);
          pass(120);
          afterAct();
          toast("\u0630\u0627\u0643\u0631\u062A \u0633\u0627\u0639\u062A\u064A\u0646 \u{1F4DA} \u0645\u0639\u0631\u0641\u0629 +" + kb);
          if (S.know >= 100) checkGrad();
        } }
      ]);
    }
    function drawRoom(c) {
      const W = 300, H = 150;
      const g1 = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H * 0.7);
      g1.addColorStop(0, "#ffd6e8");
      g1.addColorStop(1, "#ffeaf3");
      c.fillStyle = g1;
      c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
      c.fillStyle = "#c98f5b";
      c.fillRect(0, H * 0.68, W, H * 0.32);
      c.fillStyle = "#b97d49";
      for (let i = 0; i < W; i += 30) c.fillRect(i, H * 0.68, 2, H * 0.32);
      c.fillStyle = "#bfe6ff";
      c.fillRect(120, 18, 60, 48);
      c.strokeStyle = "#fff";
      c.lineWidth = 3;
      c.strokeRect(120, 18, 60, 48);
      c.beginPath();
      c.moveTo(150, 18);
      c.lineTo(150, 66);
      c.moveTo(120, 42);
      c.lineTo(180, 42);
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#ffc4da";
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(135, 34, 3, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      const has = (k) => S.furn.includes(k);
      if (has("rug")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#c78bd9";
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(150, 128, 70, 12, 0, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      if (has("bed")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#fff";
        c.fillRect(205, 70, 80, 36);
        c.fillStyle = "#ff8fb1";
        c.fillRect(205, 86, 80, 24);
        c.fillStyle = "#fff";
        c.fillRect(208, 74, 22, 12);
      } else {
        c.fillStyle = "#d8c7e0";
        c.fillRect(215, 88, 60, 20);
      }
      if (has("desk")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#8a5a3a";
        c.fillRect(20, 86, 60, 6);
        c.fillRect(24, 92, 5, 26);
        c.fillRect(71, 92, 5, 26);
        c.fillStyle = "#4aa3ff";
        c.fillRect(34, 70, 26, 16);
      }
      if (has("shelf")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#8a5a3a";
        c.fillRect(20, 30, 70, 5);
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
          c.fillStyle = ["#ff6fa5", "#4fb4ff", "#ffd23f", "#8e6bff"][i % 4];
          c.fillRect(24 + i * 9, 18, 7, 12);
        }
      }
      if (has("poster")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#fff";
        c.fillRect(205, 20, 36, 46);
        c.fillStyle = "#ff6fa5";
        c.fillRect(209, 24, 28, 38);
        c.fillStyle = "#ffe0c8";
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(223, 38, 7, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
        c.fillStyle = "#7b4bd6";
        c.fillRect(214, 36, 18, 5);
      }
      if (has("plant")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#b9692f";
        c.fillRect(5, 100, 16, 14);
        c.fillStyle = "#3fb55e";
        c.beginPath();
        c.ellipse(13, 92, 12, 12, 0, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
      }
      if (has("lamp")) {
        c.fillStyle = "#ffe27a";
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(100, 100, 10, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
        c.fillStyle = "#ffe27a66";
        c.beginPath();
        c.arc(100, 100, 22, 0, 7);
        c.fill();
        c.fillStyle = "#666";
        c.fillRect(99, 108, 3, 10);
      }
      if (S.pet) {
        drawPet(c, 255, 128, 1.3, S.pet.type);
      }
      person(c, 150, 128, 1.35, { ...playerOpts(), outfit: S.outfit });
    }
    function menuRoom() {
      menu("\u{1F6CB}\uFE0F \u063A\u0631\u0641\u062A\u0643", '<canvas id="rc" width="300" height="150" style="width:100%;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #f0b6d0"></canvas>', Object.keys(FURN).map((k) => {
        const f = FURN[k], has = S.furn.includes(k);
        return { t: `${f.e} ${f.n} ${has ? "\u2714 \u0645\u0639\u0627\u0643" : "\u2022 " + f.price + " \u062C"}`, s: f.d, dis: has, fn: () => {
          if (!spend(f.price)) return;
          S.furn.push(k);
          pass(20);
          hud();
          toast("\u0627\u062A\u062D\u0637\u062A \u0641\u064A \u063A\u0631\u0641\u062A\u0643 \u2728");
          menuRoom();
        } };
      }));
      drawRoom($("#rc").getContext("2d"));
    }
    function drawPet(c, x, y, u, type) {
      const col = PETS[type].c;
      c.save();
      c.translate(x, y);
      c.scale(u, u);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.2)";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(0, 1, 8, 2.5, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = col;
      c.strokeStyle = "#4a2c4f";
      c.lineWidth = 0.7;
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(0, -6, 8, 6, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.stroke();
      if (type === "cat") {
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(7, -8);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(15, -12, 12, -18);
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-4, -12, 6.5, 5.8, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.stroke();
      c.beginPath();
      if (type === "bunny") {
        c.ellipse(-6, -22, 1.8, 5, -0.2, 0, 7);
        c.ellipse(-2, -22, 1.8, 5, 0.2, 0, 7);
      } else if (type === "dog") {
        c.ellipse(-9, -12, 2.6, 5, 0.3, 0, 7);
        c.ellipse(1, -12, 2.6, 5, -0.3, 0, 7);
      } else {
        c.moveTo(-9, -15);
        c.lineTo(-8, -21);
        c.lineTo(-5, -16);
        c.moveTo(-3, -16);
        c.lineTo(0, -21);
        c.lineTo(1, -15);
      }
      c.fill();
      c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle = "#14102a";
      c.beginPath();
      c.ellipse(-6.2, -12, 1.2, 1.7, 0, 0, 7);
      c.ellipse(-1.8, -12, 1.2, 1.7, 0, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#fff";
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(-6.5, -12.8, 0.5, 0, 7);
      c.arc(-2.1, -12.8, 0.5, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.fillStyle = "#ff8fb1";
      c.beginPath();
      c.arc(-4, -9.8, 0.8, 0, 7);
      c.fill();
      c.restore();
    }
    function menuPet() {
      if (!S.pet) {
        return menu("\u{1F43E} \u0645\u0644\u062C\u0623 \u0627\u0644\u062D\u064A\u0648\u0627\u0646\u0627\u062A", "\u062A\u0642\u062F\u0631 \u062A\u062A\u0628\u0646\u0649 \u062D\u064A\u0648\u0627\u0646 \u0623\u0644\u064A\u0641 \u064A\u0645\u0634\u064A \u0645\u0639\u0627\u0643 \u0648\u064A\u062D\u0633\u0651\u0646 \u0645\u0632\u0627\u062C\u0643 \u0643\u0644 \u064A\u0648\u0645.", Object.keys(PETS).map((k) => ({ t: `${PETS[k].e} ${PETS[k].n} \u2022 ${PETS[k].price} \u062C`, fn: () => {
          if (!spend(PETS[k].price)) return;
          S.pet = { type: k, hun: 80, joy: 80, name: pick(["\u0645\u064A\u0645\u064A", "\u0644\u0648\u0644\u0648", "\u0643\u0648\u0643\u064A", "\u0634\u064A\u0631\u0648", "\u0645\u0648\u0643\u0627"]), p: { x: P.x - 20, y: P.y } };
          hud();
          toast(`\u0627\u062A\u0628\u0646\u064A\u062A ${PETS[k].n} \u0627\u0633\u0645\u0647\u0627 ${S.pet.name} \u{1F970}`);
          menuPet();
        } })));
      }
      const pt = S.pet;
      menu(`${PETS[pt.type].e} ${pt.name}`, `<canvas id="pp" width="90" height="70" style="float:left"></canvas>\u062C\u0648\u0639: ${Math.floor(pt.hun)}% \u2022 \u0633\u0639\u0627\u062F\u0629: ${Math.floor(pt.joy)}%<br>${pt.joy > 50 ? "\u0645\u0628\u0633\u0648\u0637\u0629 \u0648\u0628\u062A\u062D\u0628\u0643 \u{1F495}" : "\u0645\u062D\u062A\u0627\u062C\u0629 \u0627\u0647\u062A\u0645\u0627\u0645 \u{1F97A}"}`, [
        { t: "\u{1F356} \u0623\u0643\u0651\u0644\u0647\u0627", s: "10 \u062C\u0646\u064A\u0647 \u2022 \u062C\u0648\u0639 +40", fn: () => {
          if (!spend(10)) return;
          pt.hun = clamp(pt.hun + 40, 0, 100);
          pt.joy = clamp(pt.joy + 5, 0, 100);
          pass(10);
          hud();
          toast("\u0623\u0643\u0644\u062A \u0648\u0641\u0631\u062D\u062A \u{1F60B}");
          menuPet();
        } },
        { t: "\u{1F3BE} \u0627\u0644\u0639\u0628 \u0645\u0639\u0627\u0647\u0627", s: "\u0646\u0635 \u0633\u0627\u0639\u0629 \u2022 \u0633\u0639\u0627\u062F\u0629 +30 \u2022 \u0645\u0632\u0627\u062C +4", fn: () => {
          if (S.energy < 8) return toast("\u0623\u0646\u062A \u062A\u0639\u0628\u0627\u0646");
          pt.joy = clamp(pt.joy + 30, 0, 100);
          stat("mood", 4);
          stat("energy", -6);
          pass(30);
          afterAct();
          toast("\u0644\u0639\u0628\u062A\u0648\u0627 \u0645\u0639 \u0628\u0639\u0636 \u{1F3BE}");
          menuPet();
        } },
        { t: "\u{1F932} \u062F\u0644\u0651\u0639\u0647\u0627", s: "\u0633\u0639\u0627\u062F\u0629 +10 \u2022 \u0645\u0632\u0627\u062C +2", fn: () => {
          pt.joy = clamp(pt.joy + 10, 0, 100);
          stat("mood", 2);
          pass(10);
          hud();
          menuPet();
        } }
      ]);
      drawPet($("#pp").getContext("2d"), 48, 60, 4, pt.type);
    }
    function menuWardrobe() {
      menu(
        "\u{1F457} \u0627\u0644\u062E\u0632\u0627\u0646\u0629",

    function menuCook() {
      menu("\u{1F373} \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0637\u0628\u062E", "\u0627\u062E\u062A\u0627\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0643\u0644\u0629. \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0643\u0648\u0646\u0627\u062A \u0628\u062A\u062A\u0634\u0631\u0649 \u0645\u0646 \u0641\u0644\u0648\u0633\u0643.", RECIPES.map((r2) => ({ t: `${r2.n} \u2022 ${r2.cost} \u062C`, s: r2.sk > S.cook ? `\u{1F512} \u0645\u062D\u062A\u0627\u062C \u0645\u0647\u0627\u0631\u0629 \u0637\u0628\u062E ${r2.sk}` : `\u0634\u0628\u0639 +${r2.h} \u2022 \u0645\u0632\u0627\u062C +${r2.m}`, dis: r2.sk > S.cook, fn: () => cookGame(r2) })));
    }
    function cookGame(r2) {
      if (S.money < r2.cost) return toast("\u0641\u0644\u0648\u0633\u0643 \u0645\u0634 \u0643\u0641\u0627\u064A\u0629 \u0644\u0644\u0645\u0643\u0648\u0646\u0627\u062A \u{1F4B8}");
      if (S.energy < 8) return toast("\u0623\u0646\u062A \u062A\u0639\u0628\u0627\u0646 \u062C\u062F\u0627\u064B");
      actMap = {};
      const zw = 34 - Math.min(14, S.cook / 6), zs = rnd(15, 80 - zw);
      let pos = 0, dir = 1, run = true, t0 = performance.now();
      openPanel(`<h3>\u{1F373} \u0628\u062A\u0637\u0628\u062E ${r2.n}</h3><p>\u0627\u0636\u063A\u0637 \xAB\u0627\u0642\u0644\u0628!\xBB \u0644\u0645\u0627 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0624\u0634\u0631 \u064A\u0628\u0642\u0649 \u0641\u064A \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0646\u0637\u0642\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u062E\u0636\u0631\u0627.</p><div class="ag-meter"><div class="z" style="right:${zs}%;width:${zw}%"></div><div class="c" id="cur"></div></div><button class="ag-opt" id="flip" style="text-align:center;font-size:19px">\u{1F525} \u0627\u0642\u0644\u0628!</button>`);
      const cur2 = $("#cur");
      const tick = () => {
        if (!run) return;
        const dt = (performance.now() - t0) / 1e3;
        t0 = performance.now();
        pos += dir * dt * (70 + S.cook * 0.3);
        if (pos >= 96) {
          pos = 96;
          dir = -1;
        }
        if (pos <= 0) {
          pos = 0;
          dir = 1;
        }
        cur2.style.right = pos + "%";
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      };
      tick();
      $("#flip").onclick = () => {
        run = false;
        const c = pos + 2;
        let q, mult, sk, txt;
        if (c >= zs && c <= zs + zw) {
          q = "perfect";
          mult = 1.3;
          sk = 4;
          txt = "\u0637\u0644\u0639\u062A \u062A\u062D\u0641\u0629! \u{1F60D}";
        } else if (Math.abs(c - (zs + zw / 2)) < zw) {
          q = "ok";
          mult = 1;
          sk = 2;
          txt = "\u0637\u0644\u0639\u062A \u0643\u0648\u064A\u0633\u0629 \u{1F642}";
        } else {
          q = "burn";
          mult = 0.4;
          sk = 1;
          txt = "\u0627\u062A\u062D\u0631\u0642\u062A \u0634\u0648\u064A\u0629 \u{1F605}";
        }
        S.money -= r2.cost;
        stat("hunger", r2.h * mult);
        stat("mood", r2.m * mult * (q === "burn" ? 0.3 : 1));
        stat("energy", -8);
        S.cook = clamp(S.cook + sk, 0, 100);
        pass(45);
        hud();
        menu("\u{1F37D}\uFE0F \u0627\u0644\u0646\u062A\u064A\u062C\u0629", `${r2.n}: ${txt}<br>\u0634\u0628\u0639 +${Math.round(r2.h * mult)} \u2022 \u0645\u0647\u0627\u0631\u0629 \u0627\u0644\u0637\u0628\u062E +${sk}`, [{ t: "\u0627\u0637\u0628\u062E \u062A\u0627\u0646\u064A", fn: menuCook }, { t: "\u0631\u062C\u0648\u0639 \u0644\u0644\u0628\u064A\u062A", fn: menuHome }], { noClose: true });
      };
    }

"\u0627\u062A\u0639\u0645\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0628\u0648\u0639 \u062F\u0647" : "\u0628\u064A\u0639\u062A\u0645\u062F \u0639\u0644\u0649 \u0645\u0639\u0631\u0641\u062A\u0643 \u2022 \u0628\u064A\u062F\u064A \u0641\u0644\u0648\u0633 \u0645\u0643\u0627\u0641\u0623\u0629", dis: !open || S.examDone, fn: () => {
